column1: # The STABLE blue no-signal screen = the DEFAULT value of frame-colour reg
# 0x90102f33 (set at init, NOT by any AP literal). The AP only ever writes WHITE

# colour write on the mode-4 no-signal path, or patch the init default. See

[C] set_frame_color(R,G,B) -> reg 0x90102f33 (24-bit). ONLY caller passes (0xff,0xff,0xff)=white
[C] BURN-IN colour cycle (g_osd_mode==0x0d, separate demo mode; NOT the stable no-signal screen) through g_nosig_bg_colors
[C] 8 packed-3-3-2 colours for the burn-in cycle: [0]black [1]blue [2]purple [3]red [4]green [5]blue [6]cyan [7]magenta

[C] "Zonic APPSystem_CheckPowerStatus"; DC/AC ON, DC OFF, DPMS?? ON; drives g_input_status bit 0x8 (standby/power) and g_sys_ctx+0x44b bit0 (power-on)

[C] "Power_TurnOnPanel"; panel power-on sequence

# 0x21c727 is the 2bpp/12-bit-code GRAM expander. No RGB CLUT exists (2bpp indexed,
# index0=transparent, index3=white). Blue = free-run reg 0x90102f33 boot default.
